assertion: An event exists, described as "Nagelsmann quits as Germany coach".
judge_quote: Title: Nagelsmann quits as Germany coach after early World Cup 2026 exit
evidence_cited: Germany coach Julian Nagelsmann has been asked to step down after the team’s early World Cup exit, the country’s football association DFB announced on Friday, saying the 38-year-old had agreed to go following talks with senior officials.
